product_intent: A small desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually opened by a user's thumb pressure

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by thumb pressure

verification.observable: Lid remains closed when not pressed by thumb, opens when thumb pressure is released
verification.condition: Thumb pressure applied to lid and then released

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe for users to operate during normal use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, hazardous materials or design features that could cause injury during normal operation

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble for users

verification.observable: Assembly process can be completed without special tools or extensive training

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture using additive manufacturing methods

verification.observable: Design features compatible with additive manufacturing processes and materials

requirements.statement: The storage box must maintain its structural integrity during normal operation and handling

verification.observable: No structural failure during normal operation or handling

requirements.statement: The storage box must accommodate the specified desktop-sized dimensions

verification.observable: Physical dimensions of box match required desktop size specifications

requirements.statement: The storage box must function without external power or mechanical assistance

verification.observable: Operation occurs without electrical power or external mechanical assistance

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Use
operating_scenarios.description: A user places items in the storage box and closes the lid manually, then opens it by releasing the thumb pressure

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing
operating_scenarios.description: The storage box is produced using additive manufacturing techniques
